name: Boat Wreckage
label: Quest
description: Beside a wrecked row boat in the water you find a well-cared-for knife in the mud. Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold wants any clue you find…
intro: Beside a wrecked row boat in the water you find a well-cared-for knife in the mud. Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold wants any clue you find brought back, and a feeling creeps over you that something else shares the water.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Running your hand along the mud, your fingers graze the handle of a knife. It looks well cared for, and it might be safe to assume that whoever was on the boat might have lost it. Perhaps the large chunk of the missing boat might have something to do with the loss.

You grab the knife, remembering that Ginro Hearthkindle in the Feathermoon Stronghold instructed you to return to him with any found clues. You get the feeling, however, that you are not quite alone in the water...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, welcome back friend. I hope that you were able to uncover some clue as to Raschal's ultimate fate, as tragic as that may be.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Interesting... I believe that this is Raschal's knife. You say you found it at the bottom of the water, along with his boat? Well, just the knife's discovery might not be enough to connect this to Raschal's disappearance; we do, however, have an unconventional option available to us to try and learn more.
Have you ever heard of psychometry?
